Package org.geysermc.paletter.block

Class VoxelShape

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.block.VoxelShape
public final class VoxelShape extends Object
A voxel shape as Bedrock keeps and sends it (VoxelShapesPacket): a grid with, per axis, the sorted coordinates of its planes in blocks (0 to 1 is the block), and which of the cells between the planes are filled. Immutable, with value equality: BDS keeps one shape per distinct grid, so equal shapes are one shape.

A voxel shape is a culling shape: it says which faces of neighbouring blocks a block hides. It is not a collision or selection shape (those are BlockShapes, BlockBehaviour#COLLISION_SHAPE and OUTLINE_SHAPE), and the Script API does not expose voxel shapes.

The grid is minimal, as BDS makes it: no plane that separates two equal layers of cells, none outside the filled cells. Cells are numbered (x * ySize + y) * zSize + z. The empty shape has no cells and the single coordinate 0 on every axis.

Since:
0.1.0

  • Method Details

    • ofBoxes

      public static @NonNull VoxelShape ofBoxes(@NonNull String identifier, float @NonNull ... boxes)
      The shape of a union of boxes, checked the way BDS checks a voxel shape file. What BDS refuses fails here with its message: no boxes, a box without volume or beyond 14 pixels around the block, a shape wider than 30 pixels or without a box that overlaps the block, the minecraft namespace.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the name the shape will have, e.g. my:half_pipe; used in the messages
      boxes - six floats per box: minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ, in blocks (a pixel is 1 / 16f)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if BDS would not load the shape
